description: Replies on an open review thread from list_comments, as the user's AI (Xodia shows "AI for" the user). Use it to answer a question or say what you changed, in plain words for the site owner (no file paths or code). To mention a workspace member, write @[Name](user:id) with an id from the thread's people list; anyone else stays plain text. You can't start, resolve, reopen or delete threads: a person resolves a thread in Xodia when they are happy with it. A resolved thread refuses replies.
name: reply_to_comment
title: Reply to comment
